items.title: 黃仁勳重掌輝達？川普表態支持：不是壞主意
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Back at Nvidia? Trump Says Support: Not a Bad Idea
paras: 據《彭博》報導，美國總統川普周一(16日)對黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職位表達支持，並淡化外界對黃仁勳與一名疑似中國間諜女子往來，可能危及美國國家安全的疑慮。
川普當天準備離開白宮、啟程前往亞洲時，被記者問及黃仁勳回任的可能性。他表示：「我不反對。很多人正在找黃仁勳，他們認為黃仁勳應該回去。這當然不是壞主意。」
這番談話讓黃仁勳可能回歸的議題再度受到關注。《金融時報》周一報導，黃仁勳已與親信討論重返執行長職位的可能性，部分矽谷企業高層也正籌組「戰情室」，準備為他展開遊說，爭取白宮支持。
不過，川普的立場與財政部長貝森特先前的主張不同。貝森特曾呼籲輝達進行「大幅度改革」，並向公司外部尋找新的領導人。
對於黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜女子的關係，是否使美國面臨國安風險，川普也淡化相關疑慮。
「國家安全沒有受到威脅，我們的國家現在比以往任何時候都強大。」川普說：「你知道，中國會跟我們鬥智，我們也會跟中國鬥智。」
目前傳出的回任討論與遊說行動，仍不代表輝達已決定讓黃仁勳復職。川普的表態則顯示，對於輝達未來的領導安排，美國政府高層也出現不同聲音。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday (the 16th) expressed support for Jensen Huang returning to the CEO role at Nvidia (NVDA-US) and downplayed concerns that Huang's contacts with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy could jeopardize U.S. national security.

When Trump was preparing to leave the White House for a trip to Asia, a reporter asked him about the possibility of Huang resuming the CEO post. He replied, "I have no objection. A lot of people are looking for Jensen Huang, they think he should go back. It's certainly not a bad idea."

The remarks revived attention on the prospect of Huang’s return. The Financial Times reported on Monday that Huang has been discussing the possibility of retaking the CEO position with close allies, and some senior Silicon Valley executives are forming a "war room" to lobby on his behalf and seek White House backing.
However, Trump’s stance differs from that of Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, who previously called for a "significant overhaul" at Nvidia and urged the company to look outside for new leadership.
Regarding whether Huang’s relationship with the suspected Chinese spy poses a national‑security risk, Trump also downplayed the issue.
"National security is not threatened, our country is stronger now than ever before," Trump said. "You know, China will try to outsmart us, and we’ll outsmart China too."

The ongoing discussions and lobbying efforts do not yet indicate that Nvidia has decided to reinstall Huang, but Trump’s comments show that there are differing views within the U.S. government about the company’s future leadership.

items.title: 大摩喊「最高加碼」全球股市！標普500還有15%上漲空間、AI獲利成長看至2027年
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Calls for "Maximum Overweight" on Global Stocks! S&P 500 Still Has 15% Upside, AI Profit Growth Seen Through 2027
paras: 摩根士丹利策略師看好全球股市後市，建議投資人將全球股票配置提高至「最高加碼」水準，理由是人工智慧（AI）資本支出週期仍未結束，可望支撐經濟與企業獲利持續展現韌性，並延續至明年。
根據《彭博》報導，包括Serena Tang在內的策略師週日（15日）發布的報告中指出，該行維持美股「加碼」評等，並將日本及歐洲股市評等調升至同樣的「加碼」；新興市場則維持「中立」。
此外，摩根士丹利調高標普500指數目標價，調整後水準意味著指數仍有15%的上漲空間。在其他資產方面，摩根士丹利預期美元將小幅走強，並偏好投資等級公司債及黃金。
策略師在報告中指出：「隨著風險性資產價格變得便宜，我們選擇承擔風險。」
該行表示，全球股市的投資主軸也正逐漸從超大規模雲端服務供應商（Hyperscalers）擴大至其他企業，2027年市場將愈來愈關注導入AI技術的企業能否實際創造投資回報。
摩根士丹利此時仍積極看好股市，格外受到關注。美國期中選舉及通膨居高不下，重新引發市場對AI產業能否將技術轉化為商業收益的疑慮，也使全球金融市場再度震盪。
MSCI全球所有國家世界指數（MSCI ACWI）目前較8月高點下跌逾4%，半導體股基準指數自上月初以來也已下跌23%。
不過，摩根士丹利策略師認為，MSCI ACWI成分企業明年獲利可望成長13%，企業估值帶來的壓力則將減輕，甚至可能由負面因素轉為助力。策略師指出，該指數市場共識預估本益比目前為15倍，已降至2023年以來最低水準。
策略師表示，在全球經濟成長前景維持穩健，以及上市企業持續受惠於長期資本支出與創新趨勢的帶動下，獲利成長動能可望延續。此外，2026年流動性環境收緊，已使市場估值倍數大幅下修，預期這項因素明年將不再構成阻力。
摩根士丹利建議美股採取「景氣循環受惠型優質股」（Pro-cyclical quality）策略；日本股市則可望受惠於再通膨趨勢。該行認為，通縮壓力仍拖累中國股市，估值考量下則偏好南韓股市勝於台灣股市。
債券方面，摩根士丹利偏好德國公債及英國公債，因市場目前反映的英國央行升息幅度高於該行預期，同時對歐洲央行2028年降息的預期則低於該行看法。
美國公債方面，策略師預估，聯準會預計還會升息兩次，可能推動美國10年期公債殖利率在明年上半年升至5.05%。
策略師指出，目前市場定價偏向反映較鷹派的政策結果，但摩根士丹利預期，G10主要經濟體多數國家的公債殖利率將低於遠期利率所反映的水準，尤其是2028年，殖利率曲線也可能趨於陡峭。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Morgan Stanley strategists are bullish on the outlook for global equities and recommend investors raise their global stock allocation to a "maximum overweight" level, citing that the AI capital‑expenditure cycle is still ongoing and can continue to support resilient economic and corporate earnings into next year.

According to Bloomberg, a report released on Sunday the 15th by strategists including Serena Tang said the firm maintains an "overweight" rating on U.S. equities and upgrades Japan and Europe to the same "overweight" stance, while keeping emerging markets at "neutral."

Morgan Stanley also lifted its target for the S&P 500, implying the index still has about 15% upside. On other assets, the bank expects the dollar to edge higher and favors investment‑grade corporate bonds and gold.
The strategists wrote: "As risk assets become cheaper, we choose to take on risk."

The firm noted that the investment theme for global equities is shifting from the ultra‑large hyperscalers to a broader set of companies, and by 2027 the market will increasingly focus on whether firms that adopt AI can actually generate investment returns.

Morgan Stanley remains actively bullish on equities, a view that draws particular attention. The U.S. midterm elections and persistently high inflation have revived doubts about whether the AI sector can turn technology into commercial profit, causing renewed turbulence in global financial markets.
The MSCI All Country World Index (MSCI ACWI) is down more than 4% from its August peak, and the semiconductor sector index has fallen 23% since the beginning of last month.

Nevertheless, Morgan Stanley strategists believe MSCI ACWI constituents can grow earnings by 13% next year, easing valuation pressure and potentially turning a negative factor into a boost. They point out that the market consensus PE multiple for the index is now 15‑times, the lowest since 2023.

The strategists say that with a solid global growth outlook and listed companies continuing to benefit from long‑term capex and innovation trends, earnings momentum should persist. Moreover, tighter liquidity in 2026 has already forced a sharp downgrade of valuation multiples, a factor that is expected to cease being a drag next year.

Morgan Stanley recommends a "pro‑cyclical quality" approach for U.S. stocks; Japanese equities are expected to benefit from a re‑inflation trend. The firm sees deflationary pressure still weighing on Chinese stocks and, on a valuation basis, prefers South Korean over Taiwanese equities.

On the bond side, Morgan Stanley favors German and UK government bonds, noting that the market currently reflects a higher-than‑expected rate‑hike path by the Bank of England, while expectations for a 2028 ECB rate cut are lower than the firm’s view.
For U.S. Treasuries, strategists project the Fed will raise rates two more times, which could push the 10‑year yield to 5.05% in the first half of next year.

Strategists say the market is currently pricing in a more hawkish policy outcome, but Morgan Stanley expects G10 sovereign yields to sit below forward‑rate levels in most major economies, especially in 2028, potentially steepening the yield curve.

items.title: 川金會要回來了？川普稱訪中可能見金正恩
items.title_en: Is a Trump‑Kim Summit Coming Back? Trump Says He May Meet Kim Jong Un During China Visit
paras: 據《彭博》報導，美國總統川普周一(16日)表示，他赴中國參加亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)峰會期間，可能與北韓領導人金正恩會面。不過，美方高階官員上周才表示，此行並未安排川金會，北韓也尚未回應會面可能性。
川普周一啟程離開華府，準備前往菲律賓與中國出席峰會。他計畫在APEC會議期間，與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁舉行三方會談，如今又透露可能與金正恩見面，為這趟亞洲行增添外交焦點。
川普離開白宮時向記者表示：「我們會與習主席會面，他一個月前才來過這裡。我們也會與普丁總統會面，另外也可能與金正恩見面。」
他接著說：「這會很好，我們有機會完成很多事情。」川普並指出，與金正恩的會面可能在中國舉行，但未說明具體時間與安排。
川普過去曾多次提出與金正恩當面會談的可能性。不過，一名美國政府高階官員上周五向記者簡報時表示，總統此行沒有與金正恩會面的計畫，顯示相關安排目前仍未確定。
川普在第一任總統任內曾多次與金正恩會面，但自2025年1月重返白宮以來，兩人尚未再度見面。儘管美國與北韓之間仍存在重大分歧，川普已多次表明，希望恢復這段他形容為正面的關係。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 16th) that during his trip to China for the Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit he might meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. However, senior U.S. officials said only last week that no Trump‑Kim meeting had been scheduled and North Korea has not responded to the possibility.

Trump departed Washington on Monday, heading to the Philippines and China for the summit. He plans to hold a three‑way talk with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin during APEC, and now he has revealed a possible meeting with Kim Jong Un, adding a diplomatic focal point to his Asian trip.
When leaving the White House, Trump told reporters, "We will meet with Chairman Xi, who was here just a month ago. We will also meet with President Putin, and we may also meet with Kim Jong Un."
He added, "That would be great, we have the opportunity to get a lot done." Trump noted that a meeting with Kim could take place in China, but gave no specifics on timing or arrangements.

Trump has repeatedly floated the idea of a face‑to‑face meeting with Kim in the past. Yet a senior U.S. official briefed reporters last Friday that the president’s trip does not include a planned meeting with Kim, indicating that any such arrangement remains unsettled.

During his first term, Trump met Kim several times, but since returning to the White House in January 2025 the two have not met again. Despite major differences between the United States and North Korea, Trump has repeatedly said he wants to restore what he describes as a positive relationship.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI股又被砍！那指跌逾1% 輝達財報與Anthropic上市成焦點
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Lower as AI Shares Take a Hit; Nasdaq Down Over 1% – Nvidia Earnings and Anthropic IPO in Focus
paras: 美股周一(16日)開低，輝達(NVDA-US)財報與Anthropic預期上市在即，投資人態度審慎，AI交易賣壓持續。輝達領跌科技股，那斯達克綜合指數開盤跌逾1%，標普500指數連續第三個交易日走低。本周兩大AI市場事件，將成為檢驗科技股估值與投資信心的關鍵。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近170點或近0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近340點1.4%，標普 500 指數跌0.9%，費城半導體指數跌逾4.0%，台積電ADR跌近3.9%。
科技股賣壓延續至新的一周。投資人在輝達(NVDA-US)財報與Anthropic預期上市前降低風險曝險，周一那斯達克100指數期貨下跌1.4%，標普500指數期貨下跌0.7%。輝達盤前跌逾3%，晶片股與加密貨幣相關股票同步走弱，比特幣也延續跌勢。
除了兩大AI市場焦點，本周還有美國總統川普與中國、俄羅斯領導人的會談，以及美國零售銷售數據和聯準會(Fed)會議紀錄，將考驗投資人對科技股、利率與全球風險的判斷。

輝達財報不只看數字 中國曝險與融資布局成焦點

黃仁勳卸下執行長職務後，輝達仍處於市場關注中心，其出口管制合規情況正面臨更嚴格檢視。投資人等待新領導團隊說明策略與AI業務展望，選擇權市場目前反映，周二財報公布後，股價可能出現約7.8%的波動。
美國財政部長貝森特呼籲輝達進行「大幅度」改革，部分黃仁勳盟友則正推動他回歸。與此同時，美國商務部公布暫行最終規則，限制遠端存取先進AI晶片。
Bank J. Safra Sarasin策略師Wolf von Rotberg表示，財報表面數字可能退居次要，市場更在意輝達對中國的實際銷售曝險。
他指出，黃仁勳曾是複雜融資架構的重要推手，這些安排有助支撐輝達晶片需求，因此新任執行長如何說明未來方向，也將是投資人仔細聆聽的重點。

Anthropic上市牽動信心 AI多頭等待新催化劑

另一項重頭戲是Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)。該公司與部分股東尋求透過股票發售及另一筆私募，合計籌資最高904億美元。
Panmure Liberum策略師Joachim Klement認為，市場將聚焦Anthropic獲得多少超額認購，以及開始交易後的股價表現。若上市初期走勢強勁，將有助提振AI多頭信心。
儘管科技股近期震盪，全球股市上周仍有所回穩。MSCI全球股票指數上漲2.5%，終結連續四周跌勢，不過周一再回落0.4%。
這使本周兩大AI事件格外關鍵：輝達必須回應既有商業模式與成長前景的疑問，Anthropic則將接受公開市場對AI企業估值與籌資能力的檢驗。

升息預期未退 大摩仍建議全球股票加碼至最高

利率方面，交易員正等待Fed主席華許周一稍晚的談話，以評估近期美債賣壓後的政策訊號。貨幣市場仍完全反映12月升息1碼，以及明年至少再升息兩次的預期。
瑞穗金融集團(MFG-US)分析師Evelyne Gomez-Liechti指出，單靠Fed官員談話就引發新一波明顯拋售的門檻已相當高。周二零售銷售與周三聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議紀錄，對市場能否確認目前反映的2027年緊縮幅度，可能更為重要。
其他資產方面，布蘭特原油跌破每桶95美元，交易員權衡中東緊張局勢與實體市場供應充裕的影響；美債價格震盪，美元則大致持平。
面對市場波動，摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師仍建議將全球股票配置提高至「最高加碼」水準，認為AI資本支出周期尚未中斷，可望支撐經濟與企業獲利成長延續至明年。
大摩指出，風險資產價格回落後，投資吸引力增加，而股票市場的機會正從大型雲端業者向外擴散，2027年將愈來愈聚焦企業導入AI後能創造多少回報。該行另預期美元將溫和上漲，並偏好投資等級公司債與黃金。

paras_en: U.S. stocks opened lower on Monday (the 16th) as investors remained cautious ahead of Nvidia (NVDA-US) earnings and the anticipated Anthropic IPO, keeping AI‑related selling pressure alive. Nvidia led the decline in tech stocks, with the Nasdaq Composite opening down more than 1%, and the S&P 500 falling for the third consecutive trading day. This week’s two major AI‑market events will be key tests of tech‑stock valuations and investor confidence.

Before the deadline, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down about 170 points, or roughly 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite fell nearly 340 points (1.4%), the S&P 500 slipped 0.9%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped over 4.0%, and TSMC ADRs were down about 3.9%.

Tech‑stock selling pressure continued into the new week. Investors reduced risk exposure ahead of Nvidia’s earnings and the expected Anthropic listing, with Nasdaq‑100 futures down 1.4% and S&P 500 futures down 0.7% on Monday. Nvidia was down more than 3% in pre‑market trading, and chip stocks along with crypto‑related equities weakened, while Bitcoin also kept falling.

In addition to the two AI‑related headlines, this week features talks between U.S. President Trump and leaders of China and Russia, as well as U.S. retail sales data and the Federal Reserve’s meeting minutes, all of which will test investors’ views on tech stocks, interest rates and global risk.

Nvidia’s earnings story goes beyond the numbers – its exposure to China and financing structure are now in focus. After Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, Nvidia remains under the market’s spotlight, with export‑control compliance under tighter scrutiny. Investors await the new leadership team’s strategy and AI‑business outlook; options markets currently imply roughly a 7.8% price swing after Tuesday’s earnings release.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen called for “significant” reforms at Nvidia, while some of Jensen Huang’s allies are pushing for his return. At the same time, the U.S. Commerce Department released interim final rules that restrict remote access to advanced AI chips.
Bank J. Safra Sarasin strategist Wolf von Rotberg said the headline numbers in the earnings may become secondary, as the market is more concerned with Nvidia’s actual sales exposure to China.

He noted that Jensen Huang was a key driver of complex financing structures that helped support demand for Nvidia chips, so how the new CEO explains the future direction will be a focal point for investors.

Anthropic’s IPO is another headline that could boost confidence. The company and some shareholders are seeking to raise up to $90.4 billion through a combination of a public offering and a private placement.

Panmure Liberum strategist Joachim Klement believes the market will focus on how much oversubscription Anthropic receives and its post‑listing share performance. A strong early trading debut could lift AI‑bull sentiment.
Despite recent tech‑stock volatility, global markets steadied last week. The MSCI World Index rose 2.5%, ending a four‑week losing streak, though it slipped 0.4% on Monday.

That makes the two AI events this week especially critical: Nvidia must address questions about its business model and growth outlook, while Anthropic will face the market’s test of AI‑company valuation and fundraising ability.

Rate‑hike expectations have not faded, and Morgan Stanley still recommends increasing global equity exposure to the maximum level. Traders are awaiting Fed Chair Waller’s remarks later Monday to gauge policy signals after recent Treasury sell‑offs. Money markets fully price in a one‑point hike in December and at least two more hikes next year.

Mizuho Financial Group analyst Evelyne Gomez‑Liechti noted that the threshold for a new wave of clear‑cut selling triggered solely by Fed comments is now quite high. Retail sales data on Tuesday and the FOMC minutes on Wednesday may be more decisive for confirming the current 2027 tightening path the market is pricing in.
Other assets: Brent crude fell below $95 a barrel as traders weighed Middle‑East tensions against ample physical supply; U.S. Treasury prices were volatile and the dollar was roughly flat.

Amid market swings, Morgan Stanley strategist still advises raising global equity allocations to the “maximum overweight” level, arguing that the AI capital‑expenditure cycle is not yet broken and can sustain economic and corporate earnings growth into next year.

Morgan Stanley adds that after risk‑asset prices retreat, investment appeal improves, and equity opportunities are spreading beyond the biggest cloud providers, with 2027 increasingly focused on the returns companies can generate after adopting AI. The bank also expects a modest dollar rise and favors investment‑grade corporate bonds and gold.

The U.S. Commerce Department acted on Monday to block a loophole that allowed Chinese firms to rent Nvidia (NVDA-US) compute power through third‑country entities. This is the first U.S. policy response since former CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid scandal. Details on implementation, timing and affected companies have not been disclosed.
Intel (INTC-US) opened down 5.96% at $56.11.

U.S. chip giant Intel faces a class‑action lawsuit alleging the company concealed the long‑term slump in PC sales, misleading investors; the issue contributed to a near‑29% single‑day plunge in Intel’s share price.
SpaceX (SPCX-US) opened down 0.73% at $138.10.

SpaceX, Elon Musk’s aerospace firm, successfully recovered a Starship upper stage with its launch tower for the first time, moving closer to full rocket reuse and rapid turnaround, and paving the way for large Starlink satellites and space‑AI data‑center deployments.
Key economic data for today: none.

items.title: 顯卡價格跳水？秋葉原RTX 5090出現22%急速降價 NAND也見價格下修
items.title_en: GPU Prices Plunge? Akihabara RTX 5090 Sees 22% Rapid Drop, NAND Also Gets Price Cut
paras: 在日本硬體市場中，輝達旗艦顯示卡 GeForce RTX 5090 和 RTX 5080 的零售價格出現了大幅下跌。根據當地市場監測顯示，在東京秋葉原地區，部分 RTX 5090 型號的價格下跌了 22.38%，從最高點的 128 萬日元降至 999,800 日元。
同時，配備 16GB 記憶體的 GeForce RTX 5080 顯示卡價格也下跌了 16.7%，從 359,800 日元降至 299,800 日元。
根據科技媒體《ITmedia PC USER》專欄作者古田雄介的現場調查，秋葉原賣場出現同款 GPU 顯示卡售價差距超過 50 萬日元的罕見奇觀。
其中，華碩(ASUS JAPAN)將包含 ROG Astral RTX 5090 在內的多款產品售價一口氣調漲至 150 萬日元以上；反觀零售商 Dospara 秋葉原本店，則將 Palit RTX 5090 GameRock 售價由 128 萬 8,000 日元大幅降至 99 萬 9,800 日元，降幅高達 22.4%，MSI 的 RTX 5090 降價超過 20 萬日元。
秋葉原店家坦言「低於 120 萬日元已算便宜」，但受限於各品牌進貨狀況不一，市場價格走向嚴重分歧。
這波降價時間點適逢 輝達執行長黃仁勳離職消息發布，引發市場聯想。然而科技媒體 Wccftech 報導指出，雖然降價發生在高層異動次日，但「無法找到兩者之間的直接因果關係」。秋葉原實體賣場資深店員也透露，現場銷售氛圍十分平穩，高層變動短期內並未直接衝擊消費端供需。
針對顯示卡價格後續走勢，日本硬體價格追蹤網站 Gazlog 分析，RTX 5080 與 RTX 5090 在 10 月底衝高後，因高價壓抑買氣而出現局部價格回檔，但全面大幅降價的可能性極低。
Gazlog 指出，輝達已將 GB202 GPU 優先分配給需求強勁的 RTX PRO 5500 工作站繪圖卡，顯示卡合作廠商已無法新增 GB202 訂單；加上顯示卡使用的顯示記憶體(VRAM)成本居高不下，使顯示卡製造商與經銷商的降價空間非常有限。
除了顯示卡市場，整體電腦硬體的儲存與記憶體市場正面臨走勢分歧的雙軌化現象。美國銀行最新研究報告指出，NAND 快閃記憶體市場受 PC、智慧型手機及雲端業者需求疲軟影響，現貨價格自 10 月中旬以來已顯著下修約 20%。隨著長江存儲(YMTC)等廠商產能快速擴充，市售固態硬碟(SSD)持續 15 个月的大漲趨勢已確定見頂並開始鬆動。
然而，DRAM 記憶體市場則截然不同。美國銀行分析團隊警告，由於三大記憶體巨頭將大量產能移轉至 AI 伺服器所需的 HBM，一般 DRAM 的供需失衡狀況將持續惡化。
市場預估 DRAM 價格需等到 2027 年年中才會迎來供需平衡峰值，且高價將貫穿整個 2027 年，真正具體的降價契機恐怕需等待至 2028 年。玩家在升級 PC 時，仍需面臨記憶體模組與高階顯示卡的雙重成本壓力。
paras_en: In Japan's hardware market, NVIDIA's flagship graphics cards GeForce RTX 5090 and RTX 5080 have seen a sharp decline in retail prices. Local market monitoring shows that in Tokyo's Akihabara area, some RTX 5090 models fell 22.38%, dropping from a peak of ¥1,280,000 to ¥999,800.
At the same time, the GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card with 16 GB of memory also fell 16.7%, from ¥359,800 to ¥299,800.
According to a field investigation by ITmedia PC USER columnist Yusuke Furuta, Akihabara stores displayed a rare phenomenon where the same GPU model had price differences exceeding ¥500,000.

Among them, ASUS JAPAN raised the prices of several products, including the ROG Astral RTX 5090, to over ¥1,500,000; in contrast, retailer Dospara’s Akihabara flagship store slashed the Palit RTX 5090 GameRock from ¥1,280,000 to ¥999,800 – a 22.4% cut – and MSI’s RTX 5090 dropped by more than ¥200,000.
Akihabara merchants admitted that “below ¥1,200,000 is already cheap,” but differing brand inventory situations have caused a serious split in market pricing trends.

The price cuts coincided with the announcement of NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation, prompting market speculation. However, tech site Wccftech reported that although the cuts occurred the day after the leadership change, “no direct causal link can be found.” A senior staff member at an Akihabara brick‑and‑mortar store also said sales atmosphere remained calm and the executive shake‑up has not immediately impacted consumer demand.

Regarding future GPU price trends, Japanese price‑tracking site Gazlog analyzed that after peaking at the end of October, RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 saw a localized pull‑back due to high prices suppressing demand, but a broad, deep price cut is considered highly unlikely.

Gazlog noted that NVIDIA has prioritized the GB202 GPU for the high‑demand RTX PRO 5500 workstation graphics cards, leaving partner manufacturers unable to add new GB202 orders; coupled with persistently high VRAM costs, the margin for price reductions by GPU makers and distributors is very limited.

Beyond the GPU market, the overall PC hardware storage and memory markets are experiencing a bifurcated trend. A latest research report from Bank of America states that the NAND flash market, hit by weak demand from PCs, smartphones and cloud providers, has seen spot prices trimmed by about 20% since mid‑October. With capacity expansions by firms such as YMTC, the 15‑month rally in consumer SSD prices has peaked and is now easing.

Conversely, the DRAM market is moving in the opposite direction. Bank of America analysts warn that as the three major memory giants shift large amounts of capacity to AI‑server HBM, the supply‑demand imbalance for standard DRAM will continue to worsen.

The market estimates that DRAM prices will not reach a supply‑demand equilibrium peak until mid‑2027, with high prices persisting throughout 2027, and a tangible price‑cut opportunity likely not arriving until 2028. PC upgraders will still face dual cost pressures from memory modules and high‑end GPUs.

items.title: 川普政府下周揭曉AI「國家冠軍」！輝達、亞馬遜、微軟入列　聯手搶攻全球市場
items.title_en: Trump Administration to Announce AI "National Champions" Next Week, Adding Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft to Global Market Push
paras: 川普政府加速推動人工智慧（AI）技術出口布局，預計最快下周公布首批超過20家美國企業，列為AI「國家冠軍」（National Champions），協助業者拓展海外市場，與中國競爭全球AI技術主導權。輝達(NVDA-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、OpenAI及Anthropic都名列預定入選企業。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，這項計畫顯示，即使輝達近期陷入風波，川普政府仍持續推進既定科技戰略。美國希望透過國家冠軍計畫，促使海外企業及各國採用美國AI技術，而非轉向中國競爭對手。
根據美國商務部計畫網站，獲得「國家冠軍」資格的企業，可加速取得晶片及其他技術的出口許可，並獲得政府協助拓展海外業務，以及取得聯邦融資的機會。這項計畫約一年前便已公布，但當時尚未正式確定入選企業。
這項計畫的目標，是將美國晶片、AI模型及其他AI產品整合成套裝方案，讓其他國家的客戶能更方便地一併採購。
不過，輝達近期的風波也讓這項計畫面臨國安層面的關注。輝達前執行長黃仁勳被揭露與一名涉嫌中國情報人員的女子有婚外情，該女子任職於一家總部設在新加坡的資料中心公司。此事促使對中強硬派再度呼籲，政府應將國家安全置於市場占有率之上，包括收緊晶片出口管制。
輝達晶片是目前最先進AI模型的核心運算硬體，也是全球最具價值的商品之一。美國總統川普過去多次公開稱讚黃仁勳，肯定他打造出帶動AI熱潮的美國本土科技龍頭。
知情人士表示，這項計畫預計由商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）宣布。盧特尼克目前面臨外界壓力，許多批評者認為，商務部未能有效堵住出口管制漏洞，導致中國企業仍可取得輝達高階晶片。
《華爾街日報》先前報導，盧特尼克在美中貿易談判期間，一直不願激怒中國。
盧特尼克預計本周隨同川普訪問中國。與此同時，商務部也準備推出新規，限制晶片轉運至中國。不過，部分知情人士提醒，國家冠軍名單的公布時間仍可能延後。
自去年夏季宣布將AI技術出口列為科技戰略的重要支柱以來，川普政府便持續聚焦將美國AI技術推向全球市場，以維持相較中國的領先地位。
AI已成為美中爭奪全球主導權的最新科技戰場。中國企業華為技術近年積極拓展海外市場，包括歐洲及拉丁美洲，試圖掌握全球5G生態系。
paras_en: The Trump administration is accelerating its export strategy for artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and expects to announce as early as next week the first batch of more than 20 U.S. companies designated as AI "National Champions," a move intended to help firms expand overseas and compete with China for global AI leadership. Nvidia (NVDA-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), OpenAI and Anthropic are among the companies slated for inclusion.

According to the Wall Street Journal, the plan shows that even though Nvidia has recently been embroiled in controversy, the Trump administration continues to push its established tech strategy. The United States hopes the National Champion program will encourage foreign firms and governments to adopt U.S. AI technology rather than turn to Chinese rivals.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s program website states that companies awarded "National Champion" status can accelerate the issuance of export licenses for chips and other technologies, receive government assistance in expanding overseas operations, and gain access to federal financing opportunities. The program was announced about a year ago, but the specific entrants had not yet been finalized at that time.
The goal of the initiative is to bundle U.S. chips, AI models and other AI products into integrated solutions so that customers in other countries can more easily purchase them together.

However, Nvidia’s recent scandal has raised national‑security concerns for the program. Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was revealed to have had an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative who works for a data‑center firm headquartered in Singapore. The episode has prompted hard‑liners to again call for the government to prioritize national security over market share, including tightening chip export controls.

Nvidia’s chips are the core compute hardware for today’s most advanced AI models and are among the world’s most valuable commodities. President Trump has repeatedly praised Jensen Huang in public, lauding him for building a home‑grown U.S. tech champion that fuels the AI boom.

Sources familiar with the matter say the program is expected to be announced by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Lutnick is currently under external pressure, with many critics arguing that the Commerce Department has failed to effectively close export‑control loopholes that still allow Chinese firms to obtain Nvidia’s high‑end chips.
The Wall Street Journal previously reported that during U.S.–China trade talks, Lutnick has been reluctant to provoke China.

Lutnick is slated to travel to China this week alongside President Trump. At the same time, the Commerce Department is preparing new rules to restrict the transshipment of chips to China. Nonetheless, some insiders caution that the release of the National Champion list could still be delayed.

Since announcing last summer that AI technology exports would become a cornerstone of its tech strategy, the Trump administration has remained focused on pushing U.S. AI technology into global markets to maintain a lead over China.

AI has become the latest technology battlefield in the U.S.–China contest for global dominance. Chinese firms such as Huawei have been actively expanding overseas in recent years, including into Europe and Latin America, in an effort to capture the worldwide 5G ecosystem.

items.title: 黃仁勳風波延燒！美方堵中國繞道租輝達算力 五國晶片交易納管
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Scandal Escalates! U.S. Blocks China from Renting Nvidia Compute Power via Third‑Country Data Centers; Chip Transactions in Five Nations to Be Regulated
paras: 美國商務部周一(16日)公布新規定，限制特定國家透過第三國資料中心遠端使用先進AI晶片與伺服器，防堵中國企業租用輝達(NVDA-US)算力、規避美國出口管制。這也是黃仁勳上周因醜聞辭去輝達執行長職務後，美國政府首項相關政策回應。
這項由商務部工業與安全局(BIS)發布的暫行最終規則，將管制範圍從晶片實體交易，延伸至跨境遠端運算服務。商務部表示，新規定旨在確保既有的敏感技術限制，不會因為透過第三國資料中心取得遠端算力而遭到規避。
截稿前，輝達盤前股價下跌2.71%，每股暫報158.43美元。

遠端租用算力納管 五國晶片交易須取得許可

商務部指出，隨著先進雲端運算服務發展，境外使用者愈來愈容易遠端存取採用美國技術的AI運算系統。新規定將使遠端使用的限制，與既有針對實體技術取得的管制一致。
依規則內容，向印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國及巴西出口、再出口特定先進半導體，或在這些國家境內移轉相關產品，都將需要取得許可。美方認為，這些國家的相關產品遭轉移至未經許可對象或地點的風險，高於一般水準。
商務部長也可在與國務卿或白宮國家安全事務助理協商後，將其他國家納入適用範圍。這項措施是提高相關交易的許可要求，並非全面禁止上述五國取得先進AI晶片。
商務部表示，新規定旨在防止特定外國人士或實體利用以美國技術為基礎的先進算力，威脅美國國家安全與外交政策利益，並限制總部位於美方關切國家的企業，利用美國先進半導體訓練高階AI模型。

輝達風波延燒 商務部執法成效遭質疑

美方公布新規定之際，輝達相關醜聞與涉嫌間諜活動的疑雲，正促使美國政府加強檢視半導體出口。商務部長盧特尼克近期也受到批評，被指未採取足夠措施，防止輝達最先進晶片可能違反出口管制、經第三國轉往中國。
商務部在新聞稿中特別指出，這項規則由財政部與白宮國家安全會議撰寫，並依兩者指示制定，顯示相關政策涉及跨部門協調。
美國財政部長貝森特上周五接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時，曾批評商務部未將位於新加坡、處於輝達風波核心的Megaspeed列入實體清單。企業一旦被列入該清單，對其出口部分產品與技術便會受到限制。
此次措施進一步處理「晶片未直接出口中國，中國企業仍能透過境外設施取得算力」的管制漏洞。美方關注的範圍，除了晶片運往何處，也包括哪些使用者能透過第三國資料中心，遠端使用先進AI運算資源。
paras_en: On Monday (the 16th), the U.S. Department of Commerce announced new rules that restrict certain countries from remotely using advanced AI chips and servers through third‑country data centers, aiming to stop Chinese firms from renting Nvidia (NVDA-US) compute power and evading U.S. export controls. This is the first related policy response from the U.S. government after Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO last week amid the scandal.

The interim final rule, issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) of the Commerce Department, expands the scope of regulation from physical chip transactions to cross‑border remote computing services. The department said the new rules are intended to ensure that existing restrictions on sensitive technology cannot be circumvented by obtaining remote compute power via third‑country data centers.
At the close of trading, Nvidia’s pre‑market share was down 2.71%, temporarily quoted at $158.43 per share.

Remote rental of compute power to be regulated; chip transactions in five countries will require licenses. The Commerce Department noted that as advanced cloud‑computing services develop, foreign users find it increasingly easy to remotely access AI computing systems that use U.S. technology. The new rules will align remote‑use restrictions with the existing controls on physical acquisition of the technology.

Under the rule, exporting or re‑exporting certain advanced semiconductors to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, or transferring related products within those countries, will require a license. The U.S. views the risk that such products could be moved to unlicensed recipients or locations in these nations as higher than normal.

The Commerce Secretary may, after consultation with the Secretary of State or the White House National Security Advisor, add other countries to the coverage. The measure raises licensing requirements for the relevant transactions but does not constitute a blanket ban on the five countries obtaining advanced AI chips.

The department said the new regulation is meant to prevent specific foreign persons or entities from using advanced compute power based on U.S. technology in ways that threaten U.S. national security and foreign‑policy interests, and to restrict companies headquartered in countries of U.S. concern from using U.S. advanced semiconductors to train high‑end AI models.

The Nvidia scandal continues to flare, and the effectiveness of the Commerce Department’s enforcement is being questioned. As the U.S. unveils the new rules, the lingering doubts over Nvidia’s alleged espionage activities are prompting the government to tighten scrutiny of semiconductor exports. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo has recently faced criticism for not taking sufficient steps to prevent Nvidia’s most advanced chips from potentially violating export controls and being routed to China via third countries.

The press release specifically noted that the rule was drafted by the Treasury Department and the White House National Security Council, and was formulated according to their directives, indicating that the policy involves inter‑agency coordination.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen told CNBC’s “Squawk Box” last Friday that she criticized the Commerce Department for not placing Singapore‑based Megaspeed, which sits at the core of the Nvidia controversy, on the Entity List. Once a company is added to that list, its exports of certain products and technologies become restricted.

The measure further addresses the regulatory loophole where “chips are not directly exported to China, yet Chinese firms can still obtain compute power through overseas facilities.” U.S. concerns now cover not only where chips are shipped, but also which users can remotely access advanced AI computing resources via third‑country data centers.

items.title: 月之暗面拆除VIE架構 衝刺港股IPO 估值已升至500億美元
paras: 中國人工智慧新創公司「月之暗面」(Moonshot AI)傳出上市進程重大突破。根據《華爾街日報》報導，月之暗面正調整上市前股權架構，計畫終止開曼群島控股公司運作，回購早期美元投資者持股並安排其再投資至中國境內營運實體，完成拆除離岸VIE(可變利益實體)架構。
報導指出，此舉旨在符合港交所上市審查標準，目標於2027年第一季掛牌上市，集資規模最高可達50億美元。

十個月估值飆升數倍

月之暗面由清華大學畢業、曾任職於Google Brain與Meta的楊植麟於2023年4月創立，憑藉大語言模型Kimi的高長文本處理能力迅速崛起。
月之暗面吸引阿里巴巴、騰訊、紅杉中國、真格基金及美團龍珠等機構參投。公司估值自2025年底的43億美元，歷經多輪融資後，於2026年10月初飆升至500億美元，十個月內翻升逾十倍。
目前工商登記顯示楊植麟在境內實體持股約51.83%。離岸控股架構初期利於引進美元基金，但在邁入上市階段時，監理機關與市場需明確釐清實際控制權與核心資產歸屬。此次股權重組雖回購開曼股份，但同時保留投資者未來透過海外實體進行美元交易的彈性。

海外市場與API服務帶動ARR暴增

商業化推進方面，月之暗面經歷了從C端流量競爭向B端開發者生態的轉型。據QuestMobile數據，2024年投入約1億美元行銷費用後，Kimi月活躍用戶一度突破2,000萬人，隨後因同業競爭加劇，2025年底月活回落至約900萬人。
面對行銷成本上升與國內競爭，楊植麟團隊將資源傾斜至基礎模型開發與海外開發者生態。研調機構Sacra與《上海證券報》數據顯示，2026年6月Kimi的API(應用程式介面)調用收入已占整體企業端營收七成以上，且自2026年2月起海外收入首次超越國內市場。
在API與國際化拉動下，月之暗面的年化經常性收入(ARR)由2025年底的1,500萬美元，於2026年8月躍升至10億美元，並規劃於年底衝刺20億美元目標。

算力成本壓力

儘管營收大幅增長，月之暗面仍須面對高昂的算力成本與公開市場檢視。雖然Kimi K3及K3.1 Pro模型在程式設計榜單上取得優異成績，但單題推理成本相較於競爭對手DeepSeek仍高出數倍，計算資源採購與推理毛利率將是影響損益平衡的關鍵。
此外，港股同業表現也提供參照基準。2026年1月上市的智譜與MiniMax在經歷初期股價大漲後均出現顯著回檔，外資券商摩根大通與匯豐證券先後下調目標價並延後損益平衡預期。

items.title: 凱基金控聖誕樹點亮城市夜空 六大心願匯聚共譜歲末祝福
items.title_en: KGI Financial Holdings Lights Up the City Skyline with a Christmas Tree, Uniting Six Wishes for Year‑End Blessings
paras: 聖誕佳節腳步接近，城市夜空也迎來年度最璀璨的節慶風景。凱基金控(2883-TW)今(16)日晚間在集團總部廣場舉行年度聖誕點燈活動，以「點亮未來．心願點燈」為主題，由董事長王銘陽、總經理楊文鈞率領集團高階主管共同出席，在數百位民眾倒數聲中，點亮24公尺、全台最高的科技聖誕樹，透過光影展演與創意互動，將民眾對健康、財富、事業、愛情、家庭及學業等六大心願，化為城市夜色中最動人的光影地景。
總經理楊文鈞表示，聖誕節是分享希望、傳遞祝福的節日，今年點燈活動以點亮未來為主題，期盼凝聚人與人之間的溫暖與善意，將每一份對未來的期待與祝福集結成光。在充滿挑戰與變化的時代，凱基金控與社會大眾並肩前行，為社會注入更多希望，攜手迎向美好未來。

點燈活動由樂團演奏聖誕樂曲揭開序幕，隨後登場的主樹燈光秀與大樓外牆光雕展演，以城市心跳為靈感，一道微光自夜色中誕生，循著節奏緩緩流動、匯聚，彷彿承載著人們對未來的期待與祝福。當全場倒數聲落下，樹頂星耀眼亮起，主樹與大樓光影同步綻放，燈光如能量脈動般向四周延伸，金色光流與繽紛色彩交錯流轉，為城市夜空譜出一場璀璨光影盛宴。凱基金控的聖誕樹自即日起展出至2027年1月8日，每晚6時、7時、8時及9時都安排整點燈光秀；11月16日至18日另有特別版雷射光雕演出，民眾千萬不要錯過。
今年凱基金控首度推出「心願點燈」互動活動，民眾可透過凱基專屬聖誕網頁（kgichristmaswish.com），從健康、財富、事業、愛情、家庭及學業六大類別中選擇心願。每日票數最高的願望類別，將轉化為當晚聖誕樹的代表燈色，讓民眾的心願直接參與聖誕樹的燈光變化，也讓這棵聖誕樹成為串聯城市期待與祝福的地標。
除了廣場活動，凱基金控也把過節氣氛擴大至周邊街區，結合韓式料理、異國餐廳、特色餐酒館、咖啡館及甜點烘焙等15個商家，推出專屬優惠，只要在凱基金控總部大樓與聖誕樹合照，上傳個人社群帳號並標註凱基金控，即可享有優惠。此外，台北嘉佩樂酒店點心坊也推出聖誕應景糕點和節慶禮盒，為歲末佳節增添甜蜜氛圍。
11月17日至12月11日凱基金控更進一步加碼線上社群活動，民眾可上網分享心願與祝福，不但讓心意透過網路傳遞，還有機會參加抽獎。
聖誕點燈為凱基金控今年的聖誕季揭開序幕，集團還將於12月22日舉辦「凱基聖誕．星光之夜」活動，除了有冬日市集，更邀請人氣歌手、音樂新秀、街頭藝人演出。凱基金控歡迎大家走進這座聖誕樂園，讓每一份心願匯聚成照亮城市的光景，一同迎向嶄新的2027年。
paras_en: The Christmas season is approaching, and the city night sky is set to showcase its most dazzling festive scenery of the year. Tonight (the 16th), KGI Financial Holdings (2883‑TW) held its annual Christmas lighting ceremony at the group headquarters plaza, themed “Illuminating the Future – Wish Lighting.” Chairman Wang Ming‑yang and General Manager Yang Wen‑jun led senior executives to attend. Amid the countdown of hundreds of spectators, they lit a 24‑meter, Taiwan’s tallest tech Christmas tree, turning the public’s wishes for health, wealth, career, love, family and studies into the most moving light‑and‑shadow landscape in the city night.

General Manager Yang Wen‑jun said Christmas is a time for sharing hope and sending blessings. This year’s lighting event, themed “Illuminating the Future,” aims to gather warmth and goodwill among people, turning every hope and blessing for the future into light. In an era full of challenges and change, KGI Financial Holdings walks side‑by‑side with the public, injecting more hope into society and jointly stepping toward a brighter future.

The lighting ceremony began with a band playing Christmas music, followed by the main tree light show and a façade light‑sculpture inspired by the city’s heartbeat. A faint glow emerged from the night, flowing slowly in rhythm and gathering, as if carrying people’s expectations and blessings for the future. When the countdown ended, the star atop the tree shone brightly, and the tree and building lights burst in sync, with beams extending outward like pulses of energy. Golden streams intertwined with vibrant colors, creating a spectacular light‑and‑shadow feast for the city sky. KGI’s Christmas tree will be on display until January 8, 2027, with hourly light shows at 6 p.m., 7 p.m., 8 p.m., and 9 p.m. A special laser light‑sculpture runs from November 16‑18, which the public should not miss.

For the first time this year, KGI launched an interactive “Wish Lighting” activity. The public can visit KGI’s dedicated Christmas webpage (kgichristmaswish.com) to select a wish from six categories: health, wealth, career, love, family, and studies. The category receiving the most votes each day will determine the representative color of the tree’s lights that night, allowing wishes to directly influence the tree’s illumination and turning the tree into a landmark that links the city’s hopes and blessings.

Beyond the plaza, KGI extended the festive atmosphere to surrounding streets, partnering with 15 merchants—including Korean eateries, international restaurants, specialty wine bars, cafés, and bakeries—to offer exclusive discounts. Visitors who take a photo with the headquarters building and the Christmas tree, upload it to their social media and tag KGI, receive the discount. Additionally, the Café Pastry Shop at Taipei’s Capella Hotel offers seasonal Christmas pastries and gift boxes, adding a sweet touch to the year‑end celebrations.

From November 17 to December 11, KGI further boosted its online community activities. The public can share wishes and blessings online, not only spreading goodwill through the internet but also gaining a chance to enter a raffle.

The Christmas lighting marks the start of KGI’s holiday season. The group will also host a “KGI Christmas – Starlight Night” event on December 22, featuring a winter market and performances by popular singers, emerging musicians, and street artists. KGI invites everyone to step into this Christmas wonderland, letting each wish combine to illuminate the city as we welcome a brand‑new 2027.

items.title: 不只「存夠錢」更要「活得好」 安聯人壽總座：善用多元保單建構財務後盾
items.title_en: Not Just “Saving Enough” but Also “Living Well”: Allianz Life CEO Calls for Using Diverse Policies to Build a Financial Safety Net
paras: 台灣正式邁入超高齡社會，當退休後的人生可能長達25年至30年，如何在通膨壓力下兼顧健康與生活品質，成為全民必修課。安聯人壽今(16)日於台北寒舍艾美酒店舉辦「2026財富管理暨健康照護論壇」，以「長壽續航 財富同行」為主題，深度探討財務韌性、健康照護與失智預防。安聯人壽總經理羅偉睿(Joos Louwerier)會中強調，長壽時代的理財思維已從單純的「資產累積」，轉向如何在漫長人生中「兼顧照護與生活品質」，並呼籲民眾透過多元保險商品建立全生命週期的財務後盾。
根據最新《2026安聯全球財富報告》顯示，受惠於AI產業帶動，台灣家庭總金融資產於2025年成長8.7%，人均淨金融資產更穩居全球第5，展現強勁的財富累積實力。然而，羅偉睿指出，隨著台灣步入超高齡社會，高物價與漫長的退休期正在改寫人們對資產配置的需求，龐大的「長壽成本」已迫在眉睫。
面對長壽帶來的健康與財務雙重挑戰，身為連續六年蟬聯台灣第一大外資壽險品牌的安聯人壽，今年持續強化商品策略布局。羅偉睿表示，安聯人壽致力於提供涵蓋醫療保障、照護準備及資產傳承的全方位規劃，透過全生命週期的陪伴，提升客戶抵禦長壽風險的韌性。
羅偉睿進一步指出，民眾可透過保障型商品因應不同人生階段的醫療與照護需求，並在自身保障與照護需求的基礎下，進一步善用投資型、利率變動型及分紅型保險商品，規劃退休現金流、穩健累積資產，或進行資產配置與傳承，協助資產有效率地傳承至下一代，讓長壽人生擁有更穩健的財務後盾與更多選擇權。
安聯人壽通路長呂佳勳亦於論壇中提出「四桶金策略」，建議將資產分為生活(預留3至5年日常預備金)、成長(抗通膨投資)、保障(醫療與長照)及退休(穩定現金流與傳承)四大帳戶，建構完整的財務安全網。
在健康照護與失智預防面向，安聯人壽特別關注台灣2041年高齡失智人口恐攀升至近68萬人的趨勢，除倡導預防醫學與日常健康管理外，更攜手天主教失智老人基金會拍攝紀錄片《她會忘記我，陪伴失智母親不留遺憾》，喚起社會對失智家庭照護資源的重視。
paras_en: Taiwan has officially entered a super‑aged society, where post‑retirement life can last 25 to 30 years. Balancing health and quality of life under inflation pressure has become a universal lesson. On the 16th, Allianz Life held the “2026 Wealth Management and Health Care Forum” at the Amba Hotel in Taipei, themed “Longevity Journey, Wealth Companion,” to explore financial resilience, health care and dementia prevention. General Manager Joos Louwerier emphasized that in the longevity era, financial thinking has shifted from simple asset accumulation to how to balance care and quality of life over a long lifespan, urging people to use a variety of insurance products to build a lifelong financial safety net.

According to the latest 2026 Allianz Global Wealth Report, boosted by the AI industry, Taiwan’s total household financial assets grew 8.7% in 2025 and per‑capita net financial assets remain the world’s fifth highest, showing strong wealth‑building power. However, Louwerier noted that as Taiwan moves into a super‑aged society, high prices and a long retirement period are reshaping asset‑allocation needs, and the massive “longevity cost” is becoming imminent.

Facing the dual health and financial challenges of longevity, Allianz Life – Taiwan’s top foreign life‑insurance brand for six consecutive years – is further strengthening its product strategy this year. Louwerier said the insurer is committed to offering comprehensive plans covering medical protection, care preparation and asset inheritance, providing lifelong support to boost customers’ resilience against longevity risks.

Louwerier added that people can use protection‑type products to meet medical and care needs at different life stages, and on that foundation leverage investment‑linked, interest‑rate‑adjustable and dividend‑type policies to plan retirement cash flow, steadily accumulate assets, or conduct asset allocation and inheritance, helping assets be efficiently passed to the next generation and giving long‑lived individuals a sturdier financial back‑stop and more choices.

Allianz Life channel head Lu Chia‑hsun also presented a “Four‑Bucket Strategy” at the forum, recommending that assets be divided into four accounts: living (a 3‑to‑5‑year daily reserve), growth (inflation‑beating investments), protection (medical and long‑term care) and retirement (stable cash flow and inheritance), to build a complete financial safety net.

Regarding health care and dementia prevention, Allianz Life highlighted the trend that Taiwan’s elderly dementia population could rise to nearly 680,000 by 2041. In addition to promoting preventive medicine and daily health management, the insurer partnered with the Catholic Dementia Elderly Foundation to produce the documentary “She Will Forget Me, Accompanying a Dementia Mother Without Regret,” raising societal awareness of care resources for families dealing with dementia.

items.title: 台光電：輝達對台光電的營收占比從未超過20%
items.title_en: Taiwan Optical: Nvidia's Revenue Share for Taiwan Optical Has Never Exceeded 20%
paras: CCL廠接連往高頻高速材料發展的同時，近期因黃仁勳辭任輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長造成市場的恐慌，包括聯茂(6213-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)及類股股王台光電(2383-TW)股價的重挫，但台光電今(16)日發布重大訊息指出，輝達對台光電的營收占比從未超過20%
台光電的此一動作，主要起因於媒體引用本土投顧預估的2026年的輝達對台光電的營收占比為25%-30%。台光電說，此一估算數字落差太大，輝達對台光電的營收占比從未超過20%，
台光電在高速材料領域，自2017年切入市場後，於2023年即躍居全球第一，並於2024及2025年持續維持領先地位，市佔率已達38.6%，預期近期內全球市占率即將超過50%。
台光電在高速材料及HDI兩大PCB市場全球市占登頂後，Prismark於2026年7月發布台光電2025年營收已躍升為全球整體CCL產業第一名，較2024年的第三名大幅提升，並超越生益與建滔，正式登上全球產業龍頭地位。
台光電在2026第三季的獲利表現突出，從過去六季「每季賺一個股本」，躍升至今年第三季「每月賺逾一個股本」， 台光電2026年前三季營收1412.27億元，毛利率34.47 %，年增4.19個百分點，2026年1-3季稅後純益297.13億元，年增1.72倍，每股純益達82.92元。
台光電今天股價以跌停價3795元作收，較前一日收盤價下跌420元，成交2587張，單一個股成交值達101億元，三大法人合計賣超176張， 外資賣超170張。
paras_en: CCL manufacturers have been advancing high‑frequency, high‑speed materials, and recent market panic triggered by Jensen Huang’s resignation as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA‑US) dragged down stocks such as Lianmao (6213‑TW), TaiYao (6274‑TW) and sector leader Taiwan Optical (2383‑TW). Taiwan Optical announced today (the 16th) that Nvidia’s share of its revenue has never exceeded 20%.

The move by Taiwan Optical was prompted by media reports citing a local brokerage’s estimate that Nvidia would account for 25%‑30% of Taiwan Optical’s revenue in 2026. Taiwan Optical said the estimate is far off, stating that Nvidia’s share has never been above 20%.

Since entering the high‑speed material market in 2017, Taiwan Optical rose to the world’s No. 1 position in 2023 and has maintained its lead in 2024 and 2025, with a market share of 38.6% and an expectation that global share will soon exceed 50%.

After topping the global market share in both high‑speed material and HDI PCB segments, Prismark released in July 2026 that Taiwan Optical’s 2025 revenue had surged to the top of the worldwide CCL industry, a dramatic jump from the third place in 2024, surpassing Sheny and Jiantao and officially becoming the global industry leader.

Taiwan Optical’s profit performance in Q3 2026 was outstanding, climbing from “one equity per quarter” over the past six quarters to “more than one equity per month” in this quarter. For the first three quarters of 2026, revenue reached NT$141.227 billion, gross margin was 34.47% (up 4.19 percentage points year‑over‑year), after‑tax net profit was NT$29.713 billion (up 1.72 times YoY), and earnings per share hit NT$82.92.

Taiwan Optical closed today at the daily limit down price of NT$3,795, down NT$420 from the previous close, with a volume of 2,587 lots and a single‑stock turnover value of NT$10.1 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a net total of 176 lots, with foreign investors net selling 170 lots.

items.title: 東方風能前三季EPS 8.2元 明年船隊持續擴大帶動獲利展望
items.title_en: Dongfang Wind Power Posts Q3 EPS of NT$8.2, Fleet Expansion to Boost Profit Outlook Next Year
paras: 東方風能(7786-TW)今(16)日召開法說會，累計今年前三季營收104.75億元，超越去年全年，稅後純益14.4億元，每股純益8.2元，第四季通信海纜統包工程完成營收認列，預期今年營收將創高。執行長陳柏霖指出，明年在自有船隊擴大帶動下，看好獲利展望。
陳柏霖指出，首艘新造運維船「東方先進」(SOV-1) 提前兩個月交付，並於11月正式投入與Vestas的12年期長約，開始挹注穩定現金流。此外，明年4月東方先鋒(SOV2)預計開始投入營運，下半年起加上東方宏洋(CSV-2) 、東方海峰(CLV-2)大型自有新船將陸續投入營運，可望進一步推升毛利率，帶動未來3年獲利能力逐年提高。
陳柏霖說明，目前公司旗下8艘大型自有工程船舶(含現有2艘與在建6艘)至2028年租約幾乎滿檔，至2030年預期長約鎖定率可達到70%。
陳柏霖進一步表示，目前四大長期合約包括與挪威海事服務商DeepOcean簽訂的6年期租約，協助執行歐洲油氣田產業項目，也計劃支援其他離岸海事工程的業務運行。另外，還與Vestas、CIP及風睿能源(SRE)分別簽訂，最長達12至20年的台灣離岸風場運維合約。
同時，東方風能於9月取得中央氣象署「南部海域地震與海嘯監測海底電纜計畫」20.3億元統包工程，預計2030年完工，營收認列高峰落在2029至2030年。
在資本支出方面，預估今年資本支出約71.2億元，為本波投資高峰，並在2027與2028逐年遞減，目前整體建造進度達65%，其中規劃的5艘新造船計畫已取得全額銀行融資。
此外，東方風能看好全球海事工程需求持續成長，董事會於9月通過第六艘新船(SOV-4)建造計畫，預估投資7,600萬至8,600萬美元，以搶攻國際運維商機。隨著新造船陸續交付並投入營運，未來資本支出將下降，帶動自由現金流擴大。
陳柏霖表示，東方風能將推進三大發展策略，包括加速擴大自有船隊規模、提升長期合約鎖定比重，以及市場與產業持續多元化。其中，多元業務布局上，公司已拓展通信海纜、天然氣及觀測海纜等業務，目標2030年將非風電業務營收比重提高至40%。
東方風能第三季營收44.08億元，季增2.66%，年增9.19%；毛利率19.43%，季減2.84個百分點，年減1.38個百分點；營益率17.46%，季減2.49個百分點，年減1.07個百分點；稅後純益5.76億元，季減11.84%，年減13.05%，每股純益3.27元。
東方風能累計今年前三季營收104.75億元，年增24.74%；毛利率20.66%，年減4.89個百分點；營益率18.2%，年減4.66個百分點；稅後純益14.4億元，年增1.6%，每股純益8.2元。
paras_en: Dongfang Wind Power (7786‑TW) held an analyst briefing today (16th), reporting cumulative revenue of NT$10.475 billion for the first three quarters of this year, surpassing last year’s total. Net profit after tax was NT$1.44 billion, or earnings per share of NT$8.2. Revenue from the fourth‑quarter submarine cable turnkey project will be recognized, and the company expects full‑year revenue to hit a new high. CEO Chen Bo‑lin said the profit outlook looks strong next year as the company’s own fleet expands.

Chen noted that the first newly built operation‑and‑maintenance vessel, “Dongfang Advanced” (SOV‑1), was delivered two months ahead of schedule and will be put into service in November under a 12‑year contract with Vestas, providing a steady cash flow. In April next year, the second vessel “Dongfang Pioneer” (SOV‑2) is slated to start operations, and from the second half of the year the newly built large vessels Dongfang Hongyang (CSV‑2) and Dongfang Haifeng (CLV‑2) will join the fleet, which should lift gross margins and raise profitability year‑over‑year for the next three years.

Chen explained that the company now has eight large owned engineering vessels (including two existing and six under construction) and that lease contracts for these vessels are almost fully booked through 2028, with an expected long‑term contract lock‑in rate of about 70% by 2030.

He added that the four major long‑term contracts include a six‑year charter with Norwegian marine service provider DeepOcean for European oil‑and‑gas field projects, as well as plans to support other offshore marine engineering activities. Additional contracts have been signed with Vestas, CIP and SRE (Windwise Energy), covering Taiwan offshore wind farm O&M for periods ranging from 12 to 20 years.

In September, Dongfang secured a NT$2.03 billion turnkey contract from the Central Weather Bureau for the “Southern Sea Earthquake and Tsunami Monitoring Submarine Cable Project,” slated for completion in 2030, with revenue peaks expected in 2029‑2030.

Capital expenditures are projected at about NT$7.12 billion this year, representing the peak of the current investment cycle, and will decline in 2027 and 2028. Overall construction progress is at 65%, and the five planned new vessels have already obtained full bank financing.

The board approved in September the construction of a sixth vessel (SOV‑4), with an estimated investment of US$76‑86 million, to capture international O&M opportunities. As new vessels are delivered and enter service, capital spending will fall, expanding free cash flow.

Chen said Dongfang will pursue three development strategies: accelerating the expansion of its owned fleet, increasing the proportion of long‑term contract lock‑ins, and diversifying markets and industries. The company has already broadened into submarine cable, natural‑gas and observation‑cable businesses, aiming to raise non‑wind‑energy revenue to 40% of total sales by 2030.

In Q3, Dongfang posted revenue of NT$4.408 billion, up 2.66% quarter‑on‑quarter and 9.19% year‑on‑year; gross margin fell 2.84 percentage points to 19.43% (down 1.38 points YoY); operating margin slipped 2.49 points to 17.46% (down 1.07 points YoY); net profit after tax was NT$576 million, down 11.84% QoQ and 13.05% YoY, with EPS of NT$3.27.

For the first three quarters of the year, cumulative revenue reached NT$10.475 billion, up 24.74% YoY; gross margin was 20.66%, down 4.89 percentage points YoY; operating margin was 18.2%, down 4.66 points YoY; net profit after tax was NT$1.44 billion, up 1.6% YoY, and EPS was NT$8.2.

items.title: 貝爾威勒將轉上市 前三季EPS 34.61元創新高
items.title_en: BelWiller to Go Public, Q3 EPS Hits Record High of NT$34.61
paras: 連接器廠貝爾威勒(7861-TW)今(16)日舉辦上市前業績發表會，董事長徐瑞瑛看好明年成長，將持續深化AI機櫃高電流供電與高速互連產品布局，並朝800V高壓直流供電及EBO擴束光學連接技術延伸，掌握下一代AI資料中心升級商機。
貝爾威勒第三季營收25.60億元，年增80.02%、毛利率55.89%，年減0.70個百分點、營業利益9.75億元，年增94.78%、營業利益率38.09%，年增2.88個百分點、稅後純益7.60億元，年增95.60%、每股純益11.77元。
貝爾威勒前三季累計營收75.98億元，年增134.77%、毛利率54.53%，年增2.57個百分點、營業利益29.19億元，年增189.10%、營業利益率38.42%，年增7.22個百分點、稅後純益22.36億元，年增218.17%、每股純益34.61元。

在AI伺服器產品布局方面，貝爾威勒持續深化高電流與精密連接技術，產品涵蓋12V及48V BBC電源線組、HPSU／CRPS電源連接器、Busbar匯流排連接方案，以及ZANFLEX、ZANTOR及CrystalBand Floating Plug等產品，滿足AI伺服器高功率供電、高密度配置及連接可靠性需求。因應AI資料中心朝800V高壓直流供電發展，公司也推出BBC to Busbar及BBC to Wire等解決方案。
高速傳輸方面，貝爾威勒從電連接技術延伸至光通訊，布局光模組及主動式光纜(AOC)，未來將進一步拓展EBO(Expanded Beam Optics，擴束光學)技術，切入AI資料中心高速傳輸及高密度光連接應用。
董事長徐瑞瑛指出，公司以客戶需求為核心，從產品開發初期即參與設計，提供客製化連接方案。其中，12V PIC PWR連接器獲OCP協會採用，並授權全球7家業者進行產品測試；公司也參與PCI-SIG、JEDEC、USB-IF及OCP等國際標準組織。截至2026年7月，累計取得367件專利。
客戶及製造布局方面，貝爾威勒累計服務1,109家客戶，涵蓋國際晶片、雲端服務、電腦品牌及電子製造業者，並以桃園總部為營運中心，在台灣平鎮、中國昆山及越南興安省設廠，具備研發、模具設計、塑膠射出、金屬加工、組裝及檢測等一站式製造能力。
展望未來，徐瑞瑛表示，除持續深耕AI伺服器市場，也將運用既有技術拓展醫療、機器人、電動車及航太等應用，透過與客戶共同開發新產品，擴大合作深度與市場機會。
paras_en: Connector maker BelWiller (7861-TW) held its pre‑listing performance briefing today (16th). Chairman Xu Rui‑ying is optimistic about next‑year growth and says the company will keep deepening its AI‑rack high‑current power and high‑speed interconnect product lineup, as well as expand into 800 V high‑voltage DC power and EBO (expanded‑beam optics) optical‑connect technology to capture the next‑generation AI data‑center upgrade opportunity.

In Q3, BelWiller posted revenue of NT$2.560 billion, up 80.02% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 55.89% (down 0.70 percentage points). Operating profit was NT$975 million, up 94.78% YoY, yielding an operating margin of 38.09% (up 2.88 points). Net profit after tax reached NT$760 million, up 95.60% YoY, translating to earnings per share of NT$11.77.

For the first three quarters, cumulative revenue was NT$7.598 billion, up 134.77% YoY, with a gross margin of 54.53% (up 2.57 points). Operating profit totaled NT$2.919 billion, up 189.10% YoY, giving an operating margin of 38.42% (up 7.22 points). Net profit after tax was NT$2.236 billion, up 218.17% YoY, or NT$34.61 earnings per share.

In its AI‑server product strategy, BelWiller continues to deepen high‑current and precision‑connect technologies. Its portfolio includes 12 V and 48 V BBC power‑cable assemblies, HPSU/CRPS power connectors, bus‑bar interconnect solutions, and products such as ZANFLEX, ZANTOR and CrystalBand Floating Plug, all designed to meet AI servers’ high‑power delivery, high‑density layout and reliable connectivity needs. To support the move toward 800 V high‑voltage DC in AI data centers, the company also launched BBC‑to‑bus‑bar and BBC‑to‑wire solutions.

On the high‑speed transmission side, BelWiller is extending its electrical‑connect expertise into optical communications, building up optical modules and active optical cables (AOC). It plans to further develop Expanded Beam Optics (EBO) technology to enter high‑speed, high‑density optical interconnect applications in AI data centers.

Chairman Xu emphasized that the company puts customer needs at the core, participating in design from the early development stage to provide customized connectivity solutions. Notably, its 12 V PIC PWR connector has been adopted by the OCP consortium and licensed to seven global partners for testing. BelWiller also contributes to international standards bodies such as PCI‑SIG, JEDEC, USB‑IF and OCP, and has accumulated 367 patents as of July 2026.

BelWiller now serves 1,109 customers, ranging from international chip makers and cloud service providers to PC brands and electronics manufacturers. Headquartered in Taoyuan, it operates a one‑stop manufacturing hub with R&D, mold design, plastic injection, metal processing, assembly and testing capabilities, with factories in Pingtung (Taiwan), Kunshan (China) and Hung Yen (Vietnam).

Looking ahead, Xu said that beyond deepening its presence in the AI‑server market, the company will leverage its existing technologies to expand into medical, robotics, electric‑vehicle and aerospace applications, co‑developing new products with customers to broaden cooperation depth and market opportunities.

items.title: 台股黑色星期一暴跌 金管會：基本面穩健 緊盯國際金融市場變化
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Black Monday Plunge: Financial Supervisory Commission Says Fundamentals Stable, Watching International Financial Market Changes
paras: 台股今(16)日受國際金融市場波動影響遭遇沉重賣壓，加權股價指數終場重挫2,635.04點，跌幅6.03%，收在41,040.08點，成交量約8,450.57億元。針對盤勢劇烈震盪，金管會證期局公布最新統計數據，目前集中市場整戶擔保維持率仍達177.48%，且上市櫃公司前十月累計營收年增逾39%，顯示台股基本面與籌碼結構依然穩健，金管會已責成證交所及櫃買中心密切注意國際金融市場變化。
觀察今日亞洲主要股市表現(截至下午1時30分)，多數市場均呈現走跌格局，其中台股跌幅6.03%最深，南韓下跌3.83%居次，日本下跌2.11%，上海綜合與新加坡分別下跌0.76%與0.45%，僅香港逆勢上漲0.85%。
為穩定市場信心，證期局進一步揭露最新信用交易與基本面監控指標。在籌碼面部分，截至11月13日止，集中市場信用交易之整戶擔保維持率高達177.48%，距離追繳門檻仍有相當緩衝空間；同時，借券賣出占市場成交值比率僅為1.62%，並未出現異常放空情形。
在基本面與評價水準方面，證期局統計至今年10月底止，台股集中市場本益比約24.92倍，現金殖利率為1.63%，若加計股票股利則達1.67%。此外，全體上市櫃公司今年截至10月底累計營收約達55.18兆元，較去年同期大幅成長39.40%，展現台灣企業強勁的營運韌性與成長動能。
金管會強調，面對近期國際股市波動，已請證交所及櫃買中心持續密切注意國際金融市場變化情形，並呼籲投資人應回歸基本面理性評估，審慎留意投資風險。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market on the 16th faced heavy selling pressure due to volatility in international financial markets, with the weighted index closing down 2,635.04 points, a 6.03% drop, at 41,040.08 points and a turnover of about NT$8,450.57 billion. In response to the sharp market swings, the Financial Supervisory Commission’s Securities and Futures Bureau released the latest statistics: the overall guarantee maintenance ratio in the centralized market remains at 177.48%, and listed companies’ cumulative revenue for the first ten months grew more than 39% year‑on‑year, indicating that the market’s fundamentals and capital structure remain solid. The commission has tasked the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market to closely monitor changes in international financial markets.

Observing today’s major Asian equity markets (as of 1:30 p.m.), most showed declines, with Taiwan’s market falling the deepest at 6.03%, followed by South Korea down 3.83%, Japan down 2.11%, the Shanghai Composite and Singapore’s index down 0.76% and 0.45% respectively, while only Hong Kong rose 0.85% against the trend.

To stabilize market confidence, the Securities and Futures Bureau further disclosed the latest credit‑trading and fundamental‑monitoring indicators. On the capital side, as of November 13, the overall guarantee maintenance ratio for credit transactions in the centralized market was as high as 177.48%, leaving a comfortable buffer before the margin‑call threshold; at the same time, securities‑lending short sales accounted for only 1.62% of market turnover, showing no abnormal short‑selling activity.

Regarding fundamentals and valuation, the bureau’s statistics up to the end of October this year show the centralized market’s price‑earnings ratio at about 24.92 times, a cash dividend yield of 1.63%, and 1.67% when stock dividends are included. Moreover, total revenue of all listed companies reached roughly NT$55.18 trillion by the end of October, a substantial 39.40% increase over the same period last year, demonstrating the strong operational resilience and growth momentum of Taiwanese enterprises.

The Financial Supervisory Commission emphasized that, in light of recent international market volatility, it has asked the stock exchange and the GreTai Securities Market to continuously keep a close watch on international financial market developments, and urged investors to return to fundamental, rational assessments and to carefully consider investment risks.

items.title: 台股急殺逾2600點 證交所信心喊話：必要時將採取穩定市場措施
paras: 受美國科技股回檔及市場對AI產業前景預期波動影響，亞洲主要股市今(16)日全面走弱，日經225及韓國KOSPI指數盤中雙雙下挫，台股亦難逃電子權值股賣壓襲擊。加權股價指數終場暴跌2,635.04點，跌幅達6.03%，收在41,040.08點，外資大幅賣超701.89億元。面對盤勢劇烈震盪，臺灣證券交易所信心喊話，強調國際機構仍看好AI中長期需求，且台灣出口與上市公司營收皆展現強勁成長，必要時將配合主管機關採取穩定市場措施。
針對市場對AI產業鏈的疑慮，證交所引述多份最新國際研調報告指出，全球AI基礎建設投資動能並未減弱。研調機構Gartner於11月12日預測，2027年全球AI基礎建設支出將達2.397兆美元，年增高達53%；摩根士丹利11月15日報告亦認為全球AI資本支出循環持續，建議對全球股票採取最高加碼配置，並預估2027年MSCI全球指數成分企業獲利將成長13%。

至於近期市場關注輝達(NVIDIA)高層人事變動是否衝擊產業發展，國際數據資訊公司(IDC)13日分析，相關變動對未來幾季AI基建需求影響有限，雲端巨頭需求仍大於供給；花旗美股策略師亦認為，現階段斷言AI投資趨勢面臨結構性危機仍言之過早。此外，輝達機器人技術副總裁塔拉(Deepu Talla)14日於美台高科技論壇重申，台灣是輝達供應鏈不可或缺的一環，雙方合作關係緊密，顯示台灣半導體與科技業長線仍具高度發展潛力。
證交所強調，台灣企業基本面為資本市場提供堅實支撐。根據財政部統計，今年10月台灣出口金額達967.6億美元，創下歷年單月新高，年增58.9%，寫下連續36個月正成長紀錄；累計前10月出口達7,582.9億美元，年增47.7%。其中，受惠AI與高效能運算需求，10月資通與視聽產品及電子零組件出口分別年增72.9%及61.4%。
在上市公司營運表現上，今年10月全體上市公司(不含金融保險業)總營收達新台幣6兆3,269億元，年增52.40%，共有764家公司營收較去年同期成長；累計前10月營收達51兆5,306億元，年增39.87%，展現台灣企業強勁的營運實力。
面對短期市場劇烈波動，證交所表示，將持續密切掌握國際政經情勢與交易動態，強化市場監控及風險管理，並督促上市公司即時揭露重大資訊、多加舉辦法說會與投資人溝通。同時，證交所也鼓勵上市公司衡酌財務狀況與現金流量，適時評估買回庫藏股以維護股東權益。
證交所指出，倘若後續市場出現非理性連續下跌或異常波動，將配合主管機關政策，視市場狀況採取必要穩定措施。同時呼籲投資人，面對短線震盪應審慎評估自身風險承受能力，留意融資等槓桿交易風險，回歸產業發展與企業基本面理性判斷。

items.title: AI賺進大把美元 台幣為何還在貶？外媒揭台企資金留海外
paras: 據外媒周一(16日)報導，人工智慧(AI)熱潮帶動台灣經濟與出口強勁成長，新台幣卻持續逼近近十年低點。關鍵在於，企業賺進的美元未必換回台幣，而是留在海外支應擴產與投資，加上外資大舉賣超台股，抵銷出口榮景原本可能帶來的升值動能。
台灣經濟已連續四季維持雙位數成長，為近40年來最長紀錄，經常帳順差規模居全球第四。光是台積電(2330-TW)與鴻海(2317-TW)，第三季合計營收就約達1,400億美元。然而，新台幣今年以來仍貶值逾4%，呈現經濟強、匯率弱的兩樣情。

企業美元留海外 擴產投資排擠換匯需求

法國巴黎銀行估計，台灣企業自2020年以來，已在離岸帳戶累積約2,400億美元，支應對外投資與全球產能擴張。央行近期雖試圖引導出口美元回流、增加台幣需求，仍未能扭轉匯率弱勢。
法國外貿銀行亞太首席經濟學家Alicia Garcia Herrero表示，央行積極希望出口商將美元收入換成台幣，但企業意願不高。
企業保留美元有實際營運需求。台積電幾乎所有營收都以美元收取，超過一半設備款項須支付至海外；廣達(2382-TW)則持有約320億美元的美元資產，同時有約310億美元外幣負債，降低將資金換成台幣的必要性。
地緣政治與生產基地分散也推動資金外移。政府資料顯示，今年截至9月，核准對外投資金額達創紀錄的660億美元，接近2025年全年的兩倍，其中流向北美的金額年增逾六倍。

出口收入未必換台幣 外資賣股再添壓力

美元資金即使留在國內，也未必轉為台幣。央行資料顯示，9月外幣存款攀升至新台幣10兆元的歷史新高，主要由企業帳戶帶動，反映美元較高收益與營運需求的吸引力。
華僑銀行外匯策略師Christopher Wong指出，台灣第二季經常帳順差約585億美元，但金融帳資產淨增加約538億美元，兩者規模接近，反映居民持有美元存款與海外投資資產的需求。
這意味著，強勁出口雖能創造大量美元收入，卻不一定帶來等量的台幣淨買盤。
外資賣股進一步加重壓力。今年以來，外資淨賣超台股達創紀錄的新台幣3兆元。台股在新興市場指數的權重增加，加上市場對AI估值的疑慮，促使海外基金獲利了結。
央行總裁楊金龍周一向立委表示，10月至11月初進場調節匯市的頻率增加，近期匯率波動主要與外資賣股匯出有關，而非台美利差。

美元保單與股息安排 台幣面臨結構性變化

除了企業與外資動向，金融商品的變化也可能減少台幣買盤。台灣壽險業持有約7,000億美元海外資產，業者積極向本地家庭銷售美元計價保單，帶動美元需求。
加拿大皇家銀行資本市場亞洲宏觀策略師Abbas Keshvani指出，美元保單將匯率風險轉由保戶承擔，而一般家庭較少像金融機構一樣進行匯率避險，因此可能減少原本透過賣出美元進行避險、間接支撐台幣的交易。
企業股息安排也可能強化這項趨勢。台積電計畫自2027年起，直接以美元向外國投資人配發股息。此舉雖有助降低季節性換匯造成的市場波動，也會減少美元兌換台幣的交易需求。
Keshvani認為，以美元配息是美元化的一種形式。股東收到美元後，可能保留部分美元資產，進而增加美元需求，或降低對台幣的需求。

items.title: 黃仁勳重掌輝達？川普表態支持：不是壞主意
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Back at Nvidia? Trump Says Support: Not a Bad Idea
paras: 據《彭博》報導，美國總統川普周一(16日)對黃仁勳重返輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職位表達支持，並淡化外界對黃仁勳與一名疑似中國間諜女子往來，可能危及美國國家安全的疑慮。
川普當天準備離開白宮、啟程前往亞洲時，被記者問及黃仁勳回任的可能性。他表示：「我不反對。很多人正在找黃仁勳，他們認為黃仁勳應該回去。這當然不是壞主意。」
這番談話讓黃仁勳可能回歸的議題再度受到關注。《金融時報》周一報導，黃仁勳已與親信討論重返執行長職位的可能性，部分矽谷企業高層也正籌組「戰情室」，準備為他展開遊說，爭取白宮支持。
不過，川普的立場與財政部長貝森特先前的主張不同。貝森特曾呼籲輝達進行「大幅度改革」，並向公司外部尋找新的領導人。
對於黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜女子的關係，是否使美國面臨國安風險，川普也淡化相關疑慮。
「國家安全沒有受到威脅，我們的國家現在比以往任何時候都強大。」川普說：「你知道，中國會跟我們鬥智，我們也會跟中國鬥智。」
目前傳出的回任討論與遊說行動，仍不代表輝達已決定讓黃仁勳復職。川普的表態則顯示，對於輝達未來的領導安排，美國政府高層也出現不同聲音。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday (the 16th) expressed support for Jensen Huang returning to the CEO role at Nvidia (NVDA-US) and downplayed concerns that Huang's contacts with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy could jeopardize U.S. national security.

When Trump was preparing to leave the White House for a trip to Asia, a reporter asked him about the possibility of Huang resuming the CEO post. He replied, "I have no objection. A lot of people are looking for Jensen Huang, they think he should go back. It's certainly not a bad idea."

The remarks revived attention on the prospect of Huang’s return. The Financial Times reported on Monday that Huang has been discussing the possibility of retaking the CEO position with close allies, and some senior Silicon Valley executives are forming a "war room" to lobby on his behalf and seek White House backing.
However, Trump’s stance differs from that of Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, who previously called for a "significant overhaul" at Nvidia and urged the company to look outside for new leadership.
Regarding whether Huang’s relationship with the suspected Chinese spy poses a national‑security risk, Trump also downplayed the issue.
"National security is not threatened, our country is stronger now than ever before," Trump said. "You know, China will try to outsmart us, and we’ll outsmart China too."

The ongoing discussions and lobbying efforts do not yet indicate that Nvidia has decided to reinstall Huang, but Trump’s comments show that there are differing views within the U.S. government about the company’s future leadership.

items.title: 大摩喊「最高加碼」全球股市！標普500還有15%上漲空間、AI獲利成長看至2027年
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Calls for "Maximum Overweight" on Global Stocks! S&P 500 Still Has 15% Upside, AI Profit Growth Seen Through 2027
paras: 摩根士丹利策略師看好全球股市後市，建議投資人將全球股票配置提高至「最高加碼」水準，理由是人工智慧（AI）資本支出週期仍未結束，可望支撐經濟與企業獲利持續展現韌性，並延續至明年。
根據《彭博》報導，包括Serena Tang在內的策略師週日（15日）發布的報告中指出，該行維持美股「加碼」評等，並將日本及歐洲股市評等調升至同樣的「加碼」；新興市場則維持「中立」。
此外，摩根士丹利調高標普500指數目標價，調整後水準意味著指數仍有15%的上漲空間。在其他資產方面，摩根士丹利預期美元將小幅走強，並偏好投資等級公司債及黃金。
策略師在報告中指出：「隨著風險性資產價格變得便宜，我們選擇承擔風險。」
該行表示，全球股市的投資主軸也正逐漸從超大規模雲端服務供應商（Hyperscalers）擴大至其他企業，2027年市場將愈來愈關注導入AI技術的企業能否實際創造投資回報。
摩根士丹利此時仍積極看好股市，格外受到關注。美國期中選舉及通膨居高不下，重新引發市場對AI產業能否將技術轉化為商業收益的疑慮，也使全球金融市場再度震盪。
MSCI全球所有國家世界指數（MSCI ACWI）目前較8月高點下跌逾4%，半導體股基準指數自上月初以來也已下跌23%。
不過，摩根士丹利策略師認為，MSCI ACWI成分企業明年獲利可望成長13%，企業估值帶來的壓力則將減輕，甚至可能由負面因素轉為助力。策略師指出，該指數市場共識預估本益比目前為15倍，已降至2023年以來最低水準。
策略師表示，在全球經濟成長前景維持穩健，以及上市企業持續受惠於長期資本支出與創新趨勢的帶動下，獲利成長動能可望延續。此外，2026年流動性環境收緊，已使市場估值倍數大幅下修，預期這項因素明年將不再構成阻力。
摩根士丹利建議美股採取「景氣循環受惠型優質股」（Pro-cyclical quality）策略；日本股市則可望受惠於再通膨趨勢。該行認為，通縮壓力仍拖累中國股市，估值考量下則偏好南韓股市勝於台灣股市。
債券方面，摩根士丹利偏好德國公債及英國公債，因市場目前反映的英國央行升息幅度高於該行預期，同時對歐洲央行2028年降息的預期則低於該行看法。
美國公債方面，策略師預估，聯準會預計還會升息兩次，可能推動美國10年期公債殖利率在明年上半年升至5.05%。
策略師指出，目前市場定價偏向反映較鷹派的政策結果，但摩根士丹利預期，G10主要經濟體多數國家的公債殖利率將低於遠期利率所反映的水準，尤其是2028年，殖利率曲線也可能趨於陡峭。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Morgan Stanley strategists are bullish on the outlook for global equities and recommend investors raise their global stock allocation to a "maximum overweight" level, citing that the AI capital‑expenditure cycle is still ongoing and can continue to support resilient economic and corporate earnings into next year.

According to Bloomberg, a report released on Sunday the 15th by strategists including Serena Tang said the firm maintains an "overweight" rating on U.S. equities and upgrades Japan and Europe to the same "overweight" stance, while keeping emerging markets at "neutral."

Morgan Stanley also lifted its target for the S&P 500, implying the index still has about 15% upside. On other assets, the bank expects the dollar to edge higher and favors investment‑grade corporate bonds and gold.
The strategists wrote: "As risk assets become cheaper, we choose to take on risk."

The firm noted that the investment theme for global equities is shifting from the ultra‑large hyperscalers to a broader set of companies, and by 2027 the market will increasingly focus on whether firms that adopt AI can actually generate investment returns.

Morgan Stanley remains actively bullish on equities, a view that draws particular attention. The U.S. midterm elections and persistently high inflation have revived doubts about whether the AI sector can turn technology into commercial profit, causing renewed turbulence in global financial markets.
The MSCI All Country World Index (MSCI ACWI) is down more than 4% from its August peak, and the semiconductor sector index has fallen 23% since the beginning of last month.

Nevertheless, Morgan Stanley strategists believe MSCI ACWI constituents can grow earnings by 13% next year, easing valuation pressure and potentially turning a negative factor into a boost. They point out that the market consensus PE multiple for the index is now 15‑times, the lowest since 2023.

The strategists say that with a solid global growth outlook and listed companies continuing to benefit from long‑term capex and innovation trends, earnings momentum should persist. Moreover, tighter liquidity in 2026 has already forced a sharp downgrade of valuation multiples, a factor that is expected to cease being a drag next year.

Morgan Stanley recommends a "pro‑cyclical quality" approach for U.S. stocks; Japanese equities are expected to benefit from a re‑inflation trend. The firm sees deflationary pressure still weighing on Chinese stocks and, on a valuation basis, prefers South Korean over Taiwanese equities.

On the bond side, Morgan Stanley favors German and UK government bonds, noting that the market currently reflects a higher-than‑expected rate‑hike path by the Bank of England, while expectations for a 2028 ECB rate cut are lower than the firm’s view.
For U.S. Treasuries, strategists project the Fed will raise rates two more times, which could push the 10‑year yield to 5.05% in the first half of next year.

Strategists say the market is currently pricing in a more hawkish policy outcome, but Morgan Stanley expects G10 sovereign yields to sit below forward‑rate levels in most major economies, especially in 2028, potentially steepening the yield curve.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI股又被砍！那指跌逾1% 輝達財報與Anthropic上市成焦點
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Lower as AI Shares Take a Hit; Nasdaq Down Over 1% – Nvidia Earnings and Anthropic IPO in Focus
paras: 美股周一(16日)開低，輝達(NVDA-US)財報與Anthropic預期上市在即，投資人態度審慎，AI交易賣壓持續。輝達領跌科技股，那斯達克綜合指數開盤跌逾1%，標普500指數連續第三個交易日走低。本周兩大AI市場事件，將成為檢驗科技股估值與投資信心的關鍵。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近170點或近0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近340點1.4%，標普 500 指數跌0.9%，費城半導體指數跌逾4.0%，台積電ADR跌近3.9%。
科技股賣壓延續至新的一周。投資人在輝達(NVDA-US)財報與Anthropic預期上市前降低風險曝險，周一那斯達克100指數期貨下跌1.4%，標普500指數期貨下跌0.7%。輝達盤前跌逾3%，晶片股與加密貨幣相關股票同步走弱，比特幣也延續跌勢。
除了兩大AI市場焦點，本周還有美國總統川普與中國、俄羅斯領導人的會談，以及美國零售銷售數據和聯準會(Fed)會議紀錄，將考驗投資人對科技股、利率與全球風險的判斷。

輝達財報不只看數字 中國曝險與融資布局成焦點

黃仁勳卸下執行長職務後，輝達仍處於市場關注中心，其出口管制合規情況正面臨更嚴格檢視。投資人等待新領導團隊說明策略與AI業務展望，選擇權市場目前反映，周二財報公布後，股價可能出現約7.8%的波動。
美國財政部長貝森特呼籲輝達進行「大幅度」改革，部分黃仁勳盟友則正推動他回歸。與此同時，美國商務部公布暫行最終規則，限制遠端存取先進AI晶片。
Bank J. Safra Sarasin策略師Wolf von Rotberg表示，財報表面數字可能退居次要，市場更在意輝達對中國的實際銷售曝險。
他指出，黃仁勳曾是複雜融資架構的重要推手，這些安排有助支撐輝達晶片需求，因此新任執行長如何說明未來方向，也將是投資人仔細聆聽的重點。

Anthropic上市牽動信心 AI多頭等待新催化劑

另一項重頭戲是Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)。該公司與部分股東尋求透過股票發售及另一筆私募，合計籌資最高904億美元。
Panmure Liberum策略師Joachim Klement認為，市場將聚焦Anthropic獲得多少超額認購，以及開始交易後的股價表現。若上市初期走勢強勁，將有助提振AI多頭信心。
儘管科技股近期震盪，全球股市上周仍有所回穩。MSCI全球股票指數上漲2.5%，終結連續四周跌勢，不過周一再回落0.4%。
這使本周兩大AI事件格外關鍵：輝達必須回應既有商業模式與成長前景的疑問，Anthropic則將接受公開市場對AI企業估值與籌資能力的檢驗。

升息預期未退 大摩仍建議全球股票加碼至最高

利率方面，交易員正等待Fed主席華許周一稍晚的談話，以評估近期美債賣壓後的政策訊號。貨幣市場仍完全反映12月升息1碼，以及明年至少再升息兩次的預期。
瑞穗金融集團(MFG-US)分析師Evelyne Gomez-Liechti指出，單靠Fed官員談話就引發新一波明顯拋售的門檻已相當高。周二零售銷售與周三聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議紀錄，對市場能否確認目前反映的2027年緊縮幅度，可能更為重要。
其他資產方面，布蘭特原油跌破每桶95美元，交易員權衡中東緊張局勢與實體市場供應充裕的影響；美債價格震盪，美元則大致持平。
面對市場波動，摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師仍建議將全球股票配置提高至「最高加碼」水準，認為AI資本支出周期尚未中斷，可望支撐經濟與企業獲利成長延續至明年。
大摩指出，風險資產價格回落後，投資吸引力增加，而股票市場的機會正從大型雲端業者向外擴散，2027年將愈來愈聚焦企業導入AI後能創造多少回報。該行另預期美元將溫和上漲，並偏好投資等級公司債與黃金。

paras_en: U.S. stocks opened lower on Monday (the 16th) as investors remained cautious ahead of Nvidia (NVDA-US) earnings and the anticipated Anthropic IPO, keeping AI‑related selling pressure alive. Nvidia led the decline in tech stocks, with the Nasdaq Composite opening down more than 1%, and the S&P 500 falling for the third consecutive trading day. This week’s two major AI‑market events will be key tests of tech‑stock valuations and investor confidence.

Before the deadline, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down about 170 points, or roughly 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite fell nearly 340 points (1.4%), the S&P 500 slipped 0.9%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped over 4.0%, and TSMC ADRs were down about 3.9%.

Tech‑stock selling pressure continued into the new week. Investors reduced risk exposure ahead of Nvidia’s earnings and the expected Anthropic listing, with Nasdaq‑100 futures down 1.4% and S&P 500 futures down 0.7% on Monday. Nvidia was down more than 3% in pre‑market trading, and chip stocks along with crypto‑related equities weakened, while Bitcoin also kept falling.

In addition to the two AI‑related headlines, this week features talks between U.S. President Trump and leaders of China and Russia, as well as U.S. retail sales data and the Federal Reserve’s meeting minutes, all of which will test investors’ views on tech stocks, interest rates and global risk.

Nvidia’s earnings story goes beyond the numbers – its exposure to China and financing structure are now in focus. After Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, Nvidia remains under the market’s spotlight, with export‑control compliance under tighter scrutiny. Investors await the new leadership team’s strategy and AI‑business outlook; options markets currently imply roughly a 7.8% price swing after Tuesday’s earnings release.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen called for “significant” reforms at Nvidia, while some of Jensen Huang’s allies are pushing for his return. At the same time, the U.S. Commerce Department released interim final rules that restrict remote access to advanced AI chips.
Bank J. Safra Sarasin strategist Wolf von Rotberg said the headline numbers in the earnings may become secondary, as the market is more concerned with Nvidia’s actual sales exposure to China.

He noted that Jensen Huang was a key driver of complex financing structures that helped support demand for Nvidia chips, so how the new CEO explains the future direction will be a focal point for investors.

Anthropic’s IPO is another headline that could boost confidence. The company and some shareholders are seeking to raise up to $90.4 billion through a combination of a public offering and a private placement.

Panmure Liberum strategist Joachim Klement believes the market will focus on how much oversubscription Anthropic receives and its post‑listing share performance. A strong early trading debut could lift AI‑bull sentiment.
Despite recent tech‑stock volatility, global markets steadied last week. The MSCI World Index rose 2.5%, ending a four‑week losing streak, though it slipped 0.4% on Monday.

That makes the two AI events this week especially critical: Nvidia must address questions about its business model and growth outlook, while Anthropic will face the market’s test of AI‑company valuation and fundraising ability.

Rate‑hike expectations have not faded, and Morgan Stanley still recommends increasing global equity exposure to the maximum level. Traders are awaiting Fed Chair Waller’s remarks later Monday to gauge policy signals after recent Treasury sell‑offs. Money markets fully price in a one‑point hike in December and at least two more hikes next year.

Mizuho Financial Group analyst Evelyne Gomez‑Liechti noted that the threshold for a new wave of clear‑cut selling triggered solely by Fed comments is now quite high. Retail sales data on Tuesday and the FOMC minutes on Wednesday may be more decisive for confirming the current 2027 tightening path the market is pricing in.
Other assets: Brent crude fell below $95 a barrel as traders weighed Middle‑East tensions against ample physical supply; U.S. Treasury prices were volatile and the dollar was roughly flat.

Amid market swings, Morgan Stanley strategist still advises raising global equity allocations to the “maximum overweight” level, arguing that the AI capital‑expenditure cycle is not yet broken and can sustain economic and corporate earnings growth into next year.

Morgan Stanley adds that after risk‑asset prices retreat, investment appeal improves, and equity opportunities are spreading beyond the biggest cloud providers, with 2027 increasingly focused on the returns companies can generate after adopting AI. The bank also expects a modest dollar rise and favors investment‑grade corporate bonds and gold.

This is the first U.S. policy response since former CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid scandal. Details on implementation, timing and affected companies have not been disclosed.

items.title: 川普政府下周揭曉AI「國家冠軍」！輝達、亞馬遜、微軟入列　聯手搶攻全球市場
items.title_en: Trump Administration to Announce AI "National Champions" Next Week, Adding Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft to Global Market Push
paras: 川普政府加速推動人工智慧（AI）技術出口布局，預計最快下周公布首批超過20家美國企業，列為AI「國家冠軍」（National Champions），協助業者拓展海外市場，與中國競爭全球AI技術主導權。輝達(NVDA-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、OpenAI及Anthropic都名列預定入選企業。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，這項計畫顯示，即使輝達近期陷入風波，川普政府仍持續推進既定科技戰略。美國希望透過國家冠軍計畫，促使海外企業及各國採用美國AI技術，而非轉向中國競爭對手。
根據美國商務部計畫網站，獲得「國家冠軍」資格的企業，可加速取得晶片及其他技術的出口許可，並獲得政府協助拓展海外業務，以及取得聯邦融資的機會。這項計畫約一年前便已公布，但當時尚未正式確定入選企業。
這項計畫的目標，是將美國晶片、AI模型及其他AI產品整合成套裝方案，讓其他國家的客戶能更方便地一併採購。
不過，輝達近期的風波也讓這項計畫面臨國安層面的關注。輝達前執行長黃仁勳被揭露與一名涉嫌中國情報人員的女子有婚外情，該女子任職於一家總部設在新加坡的資料中心公司。此事促使對中強硬派再度呼籲，政府應將國家安全置於市場占有率之上，包括收緊晶片出口管制。
輝達晶片是目前最先進AI模型的核心運算硬體，也是全球最具價值的商品之一。美國總統川普過去多次公開稱讚黃仁勳，肯定他打造出帶動AI熱潮的美國本土科技龍頭。
知情人士表示，這項計畫預計由商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick）宣布。盧特尼克目前面臨外界壓力，許多批評者認為，商務部未能有效堵住出口管制漏洞，導致中國企業仍可取得輝達高階晶片。
《華爾街日報》先前報導，盧特尼克在美中貿易談判期間，一直不願激怒中國。
盧特尼克預計本周隨同川普訪問中國。與此同時，商務部也準備推出新規，限制晶片轉運至中國。不過，部分知情人士提醒，國家冠軍名單的公布時間仍可能延後。
自去年夏季宣布將AI技術出口列為科技戰略的重要支柱以來，川普政府便持續聚焦將美國AI技術推向全球市場，以維持相較中國的領先地位。
AI已成為美中爭奪全球主導權的最新科技戰場。中國企業華為技術近年積極拓展海外市場，包括歐洲及拉丁美洲，試圖掌握全球5G生態系。
paras_en: The Trump administration is accelerating its export strategy for artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and expects to announce as early as next week the first batch of more than 20 U.S. companies designated as AI "National Champions," a move intended to help firms expand overseas and compete with China for global AI leadership. Nvidia (NVDA-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), OpenAI and Anthropic are among the companies slated for inclusion.

According to the Wall Street Journal, the plan shows that even though Nvidia has recently been embroiled in controversy, the Trump administration continues to push its established tech strategy. The United States hopes the National Champion program will encourage foreign firms and governments to adopt U.S. AI technology rather than turn to Chinese rivals.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s program website states that companies awarded "National Champion" status can accelerate the issuance of export licenses for chips and other technologies, receive government assistance in expanding overseas operations, and gain access to federal financing opportunities. The program was announced about a year ago, but the specific entrants had not yet been finalized at that time.
The goal of the initiative is to bundle U.S. chips, AI models and other AI products into integrated solutions so that customers in other countries can more easily purchase them together.

However, Nvidia’s recent scandal has raised national‑security concerns for the program. Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was revealed to have had an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative who works for a data‑center firm headquartered in Singapore. The episode has prompted hard‑liners to again call for the government to prioritize national security over market share, including tightening chip export controls.

Nvidia’s chips are the core compute hardware for today’s most advanced AI models and are among the world’s most valuable commodities. President Trump has repeatedly praised Jensen Huang in public, lauding him for building a home‑grown U.S. tech champion that fuels the AI boom.

Sources familiar with the matter say the program is expected to be announced by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Lutnick is currently under external pressure, with many critics arguing that the Commerce Department has failed to effectively close export‑control loopholes that still allow Chinese firms to obtain Nvidia’s high‑end chips.
The Wall Street Journal previously reported that during U.S.–China trade talks, Lutnick has been reluctant to provoke China.

Lutnick is slated to travel to China this week alongside President Trump. At the same time, the Commerce Department is preparing new rules to restrict the transshipment of chips to China. Nonetheless, some insiders caution that the release of the National Champion list could still be delayed.

Since announcing last summer that AI technology exports would become a cornerstone of its tech strategy, the Trump administration has remained focused on pushing U.S. AI technology into global markets to maintain a lead over China.

AI has become the latest technology battlefield in the U.S.–China contest for global dominance. Chinese firms such as Huawei have been actively expanding overseas in recent years, including into Europe and Latin America, in an effort to capture the worldwide 5G ecosystem.

items.title: 嬌生砸22億美元收購眼科新藥公司Ollin，最高交易金額達33.3億美元
items.title_en: Johnson & Johnson Pays $2.2 Billion to Acquire Eye‑Drug Company Ollie Biosciences, Deal Could Reach $3.33 Billion
paras: 2026年11月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國醫療保健大廠嬌生公司Johnson & Johnson(JNJ-US)週一宣布，以22億美元預付款收購德州眼科生技公司Ollin Biosciences，另包含最高約11.3億美元的監管及商業化里程碑付款，整體交易金額最高達33.3億美元，預計於2026年底前完成。這項交易將協助嬌生擴充眼科新藥研發產品組合，進一步切入視網膜疾病治療市場。
Ollin成立於2023年，雖然營運歷史僅約三年，但核心價值來自與中國信達生物Innovent Biologics(1801-HK)合作開發的雙特異性抗體OLN324（信達研發代號IBI324），主要針對糖尿病黃斑部水腫(DME)及濕性老年性黃斑部病變(wAMD)。
OLN324是一款同時作用於VEGF與Ang2的雙特異性抗體，主打更強的抑制效果與更持久的治療反應。根據信達生物提供的資料，該藥物對Ang2的抑制活性約為羅氏Roche(ROG-CH)旗下Vabysmo（faricimab）的60倍，分子量約41kDa。
臨床數據是這次收購的重要基礎。在涵蓋超過160名患者的JADE一期b臨床研究中，接受OLN324 4mg治療的糖尿病黃斑部水腫患者，近90%在第12週達到無疾病狀態，相較之下，Vabysmo組為57%。此外，OLN324在20週觀察期間呈現數值上較大的視力改善，且需要再次治療的次數較少。
不過，目前研究仍處於早期階段，視力改善幅度的數值優勢不代表已獲得統計顯著性證實。Ollin已取得美國FDA與歐洲EMA對三期臨床計畫的意見，預計於2026年第四季啟動全球三期試驗，信達生物也將協助中國及韓國的患者招募。
Ollin管理層估計，其鎖定的視網膜藥物市場規模約150億美元。作為競爭標竿，羅氏旗下Vabysmo於2025年全球銷售額約50億美元，顯示VEGF/Ang2雙靶點藥物已具備商業市場基礎。若OLN324後續三期臨床能證實療效與持久性優勢，未來將有機會與羅氏Vabysmo及再生元Regeneron(REGN-US)旗下Eylea系列產品競爭。
除了OLN324，Ollin也布局第二款雙特異性抗體OLN102，針對甲狀腺眼病(TED)及Graves病開發，由VelaVigo發現並合作研發，原規劃於2026年進入臨床階段。
